args.title: Add note about setting S3_ENDPOINT when using MinIO in README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

Add a line in the 'Running locally' steps to mention setting the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable to http://localhost:9000 when using MinIO. This avoids falling back to AWS S3 and prevents connection errors. Also suggest creating the bucket in MinIO console as a helpful note.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue reports missing guidance in the local setup instructions about setting the S3_ENDPOINT environment variable when using MinIO, which causes uploads to try AWS instead. The main README.md file should be updated to add this note in the 'Running locally' section for clearer setup and avoiding confusion. A draft pull request has been opened for this.
